vignette: A child with special health care needs and a chronic medical condition is scheduled for a restorative visit that will require local anesthesia. A resident asks why the medical history is being reviewed in detail beforehand.
stem: Which statement best explains the purpose of this review?

options.text: A thorough understanding of the history lowers the risk of aggravating the child's medical condition.
A history taken at an earlier visit is sufficient and does not need to be kept current.
Knowing the oral health risks of the child's condition has no effect on treatment planning.
Consulting the child's medical providers is unnecessary once a history has been recorded.
